# Template: pv_loop
The cardiac pressure-volume loop: one heartbeat as a closed loop of left- ventricular volume (x) against pressure (y), traversed through its four phases — filling, isovolumetric contraction, ejection, isovolumetric relaxation — with numbered phases and a legend, optional ESPVR (contractility) and EDPVR (stiffness) guide lines, EDV/ESV axis ticks, a stroke-volume bracket, and the loop area shaded as stroke work. preload, afterload and contractility are numeric, so `animate` reshapes the loop honestly (e.g. animate contractility down to show a failing ventricle). Choose this scene for ANY request about the pressure-volume loop or PV loop, cardiac cycle phases plotted as pressure vs volume, stroke volume or stroke work, ejection fraction geometry, preload, afterload, contractility, or heart failure on a PV diagram.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "preload": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "End-diastolic volume in ml, 80-160 (default 120)."
  },
  "afterload": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Aortic pressure at which ejection starts, mmHg, 50-110 (default 80)."
  },
  "contractility": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "ESPVR slope in mmHg/ml, 0.8-4 (default 2). Lower = weaker ventricle = smaller loop."
  },
  "show_espvr": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Dashed end-systolic pressure-volume relation line (default false)."
  },
  "show_edpvr": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Dashed end-diastolic (filling/stiffness) curve (default false)."
  },
  "shade_work": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Shade the loop area = stroke work (default false)."
  },
  "show_sv": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Stroke-volume bracket above the loop plus EDV/ESV axis ticks (default false)."
  },
  "labels": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Phase numbers 1-4 inside the loop plus a legend naming them (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axes: the coordinate axes (a group with captions)
- phase_fill: phase 1: the filling edge along the bottom
- phase_ivc: phase 2: isovolumetric contraction (vertical right edge)
- phase_eject: phase 3: the ejection dome along the top
- phase_ivr: phase 4: isovolumetric relaxation (vertical left edge)
- phase_nums: the numbers 1-4 inside the loop (a group, when labels)
- legend: the phase legend at the top left (a group, when labels)
- espvr: dashed ESPVR line with its caption (a group, when show_espvr)
- edpvr: dashed EDPVR curve with its caption (a group, when show_edpvr)
- work: the shaded loop area (when shade_work)
- sv_arrow: the stroke-volume bracket with its caption (a group, when show_sv)
- tick_edv: EDV tick + caption on the volume axis (when show_sv; likewise tick_esv)
- tick_esv: ESV tick + caption on the volume axis
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw the cardiac pressure-volume loop with its four phases." → params: {"title":"The pressure-volume loop"}
Request: "Show how low contractility shrinks the PV loop." → params: {"contractility":1.2,"show_espvr":true,"show_sv":true,"title":"The failing ventricle"}

In YAML: `template: pv_loop` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
